scope: Talvora Control Center responsiveness quality pass plus desktop worklog evidence modernization: protocol v2 structured evidence, real runtime timestamps/durations/files/diff/result data, WPF expandable read-only code evidence, and canonical sensitive-data redaction.

libraries.verified: Current ASP.NET Core MCP filter contract: AddCallToolFilter can wrap every CallTool request while preserving the downstream tool result. Ordinary tool failures may be returned as CallToolResult with IsError=true rather than thrown; cancellation/protocol exceptions retain their documented semantics. Talvora therefore detects thrown and returned failures, aggregates concurrent meaningful calls into one user-facing worklog card, and wraps start/progress/terminal notification side effects so observability can never alter, mask, cancel, or replace the underlying tool result.
Current Microsoft.Extensions.AI and Microsoft.Extensions package alignment guidance for .NET 10.

Current .NET disposal guidance remains enforced for Process/resource ownership. Current WPF guidance also supports standard composition with expandable content and read-only selectable TextBox evidence. Talvora's worklog keeps the primary copy nontechnical while an Expander exposes bounded real technical evidence; the evidence surface is populated only from real tool/runtime data and passes canonical FileLog sensitive-data redaction.

Current WPF-UI Snackbar guidance confirms presenter-owned nonmodal notification UX with explicit timeout; Talvora keeps the existing WPF-UI design language while using a tray-owned WPF progress card so full text, coalescing, hover pause and lifecycle remain under Talvora control.

Current WPF dispatcher guidance confirms UI callbacks execute through Dispatcher operations and recommends moving blocking work away from the dispatcher before marshaling results back to UI state. Talvora keeps the cross-process Mutex acquire/release wholly on one worker thread, performs bounded event-history and raw-log file reads through async worker boundaries, parallelizes independent detail health/version/event work, and uses a nonblocking gate plus selected-MCP identity check to prevent overlapping or stale live-log refreshes.
